## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION: Risk negative / Cycle positive; Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Financials and Materials leading while Tech is mixed; Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: NEM (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +28.27%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +27.78%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: COF (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +22.03%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +4.69% | 1M: +20.96%) ABOVE TREND; Technology showing pockets of strength: MSFT (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +1.36%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Real Estate and Energy showing weakness alongside Consumer Discretionary on a 1W basis; Utilities weak: NEE (1W: -1.97% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND, Utilities group under pressure. Consumer Discretionary has dispersion: TSLA ABOVE TREND but NKE (1W: -15.58% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND and broad weakness persists.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: NEM (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +28.27%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +27.78%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +25.92%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +23.66%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +22.27%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership concentrated across Materials and Autos/Staples (3 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NEE (1W: -1.97% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -4.78%) BELOW TREND, COST (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -4.85%) BELOW TREND, D (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND, DUK (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Utilities and select staples/communications.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W: EL (1W: +7.54% | 1M: +25.92%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +7.28% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +27.78%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +5.52% | 1M: +20.88%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (several large-cap names with 1W ≠ 1M such as AAPL, JNJ, UNH, ORCL) — tactical setups, not uniform regime confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but constructive: MSFT (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +1.36%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.20% | 1M: +1.69%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +7.09%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL (1W: -1.15% | 1M: +1.77%) CORRECTION. Technology contributes to rotation but breadth is uneven within the group (part of the 5/11 positive sectors).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Broad strength and confirmation of rotation: COF (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +22.03%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +4.69% | 1M: +20.96%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +8.28%) ABOVE TREND — Financials are a core leadership axis; sector participation supports a Value/Cyclical tilt.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed/defensive inkling: BMY (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +18.98%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -3.20% | 1M: +2.74%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -4.67% | 1M: +5.07%) CORRECTION — Healthcare breadth slightly lagging on the week.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and Materials exposure (COF, C, NEM, FCX) as rotation drivers and reduce exposure to Utilities and stretched Consumer Discretionary names (NKE, NFLX). Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth/Momentum given sector participation and leadership concentration; monitor tech leaders for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: NEM (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +28.27%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +27.78%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +5.52% | 1M: +20.88%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -15.58% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -0.58% | 1M: -11.77%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -4.67% | 1M: +5.07%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +12.26%) and Financials (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.12%) as rotation leaders. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -4.48%) and select Consumer Discretionary names given recent heavy outflows and dispersion.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA for hold above the recent 1W low to keep ABOVE TREND momentum; monitor AAPL for support at the last pullback low to resolve CORRECTION. JPM upside continuation confirmed if it sustains the recent 1M breakout area; NKE needs to stabilize off the steep 1W drop before re-entering rotation exposure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Value/Cyclical tilt (Financials/Materials favored); Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive and leadership concentrated across 3 sectors. COF (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +22.03%) ABOVE TREND and NEM (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +28.27%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while AAPL (1W: -1.15% | 1M: +1.77%) CORRECTION and UNH (1W: -4.67% | 1M: +5.07%) CORRECTION warrant monitoring. Key risk: major-cap divergence (multiple large names with opposite 1W vs 1M signals) — watch for trend breaks before broadening exposure.
